portalPairing.approval.body: The team approves every new device for this beta. Keep this page open, and it finishes the pairing as soon as the team approves.
portalPairing.approval.expiry: If the code runs out first, start again. Once the team has approved this server, the next pairing finishes when you confirm the code.
portalPairing.approval.title: Confirmed. Waiting for the Prusa team to approve this server
portalPairing.clock.body: The Beta Portal checks the time on every request. Set the date and time of the computer this server runs on, or turn on time synchronisation (NTP), then try again.
portalPairing.clock.title: This server's clock is wrong
portalPairing.code.expiring: The code is about to expire.
portalPairing.code.fallback: If the portal does not open, go to {address} and type the code.
portalPairing.code.label: Pairing code
portalPairing.code.title: Confirm this code on the Beta Portal
portalPairing.confirm.body: Sign in on the Beta Portal and confirm the code. This page updates by itself.
portalPairing.confirm.title: Waiting for you to confirm on the portal
portalPairing.denied.body: The code was declined on the Beta Portal, or the team did not approve this server. Start again if this was a mistake.
portalPairing.denied.title: The pairing was declined
portalPairing.description: Pair this server with your Beta Portal account to get test releases
portalPairing.disconnect.description: This server stops getting test releases from the portal. You can pair it again at any time.
portalPairing.disconnect.title: Disconnect this server from the Beta Portal?
portalPairing.expired.body: Nobody confirmed the code in time. Start again to get a new code.
portalPairing.expired.title: The code expired
portalPairing.heading: Beta Portal pairing
portalPairing.intro.body: The Beta Portal is Prusa's beta programme, where we test new features and experimental builds before a release. Pairing links this server to your tester account, so it can download those test releases. You confirm a short code on the portal and never type a password or a token here.
portalPairing.intro.private: The private device code and the portal token stay on this server.
portalPairing.intro.title: Pair this server with the Beta Portal
portalPairing.paired.body: This server can download test releases from the Beta Portal.
portalPairing.revoked.body: The server may have been removed from your account, or your access to the beta ended. Pair it again to keep getting test releases.
portalPairing.revoked.title: The Beta Portal no longer accepts this server
portalPairing.steps.label: Pairing steps
portalPairing.suspended.body: The pairing stays, but this server gets no test releases while your access to the product is suspended. Ask the product team to restore it; you do not need to pair again.
portalPairing.suspended.title: The Beta Portal suspended your access
portalPairing.unreachable.body: This server could not reach the Beta Portal. Check its internet connection, then try again.
portalPairing.unreachable.title: The Beta Portal cannot be reached
